description: The null filling a missing optional object attribute converts into a set of objects of its type
notes: The test uses convert-with-defaults, which gives the missing attribute a a null, because hashicorp/hcl's convert fails for a value that lacks an optional attribute (native/type-expressions/convert-missing-optional-attribute). go-cty makes that null with the attribute's type constraint, which still has the optional attribute b (conversionMapToObject in cty/convert/conversion_collection.go), and the conversion to the set gives it the type without b's optional marker, the type of the converted object.
